scope: Completed original A01 sconce, A02 shrine and A03 arch/pillar/trim production through Higgsfield 3D Jutsu; local bake/LOD/runtime packaging; no catalog assets or external generation models.

official_sources.finding: Official Sep 5 guide says browser agent messages on Auto are free; specific LLM messages have model-dependent credit costs. It does not publish create_project/run_python/export API credit rates.
Official credits help says generations through MCP consume credits. It does not explicitly classify direct Blender scene edit/project/download operations or quote their cost.

Higgsfield claims no ownership of user content/outputs and does not restrict commercial use of outputs; exported-output rights survive account/subscription termination and may be transferred/sublicensed. Third-party rights and applicable supplemental terms remain relevant. No special 3D Jutsu catalog license was identified.
Official help says no separate commercial license purchase and no output attribution requirement. This does not grant blanket rights to catalog models.

credit_finding.authorization_update: Root reports explicit user authorization of 1000 total credits across this implementation, with a conservative two attempts per asset. Record balances before/after mutations; do not expand beyond pilot until root accepts gates.

execution_sequence: Record authorized shared credit ceiling and per-asset attempt limit; measure before/after balances without representing observed zero debit as an API price. G02 authorizes the original asset scope.

Create the private A01 pilot project, inspect exact project revision/scene sequence, author one coherent original bpy scene and record the returned operation before polling. Do not guess guards or concurrently mutate the same project.

Retrieve committed editable blend, GLB and published preview at the exact revision. Keep receipts and source hashes. Raw procedural exports may omit shader appearance; bake the committed blend locally into portable base/normal/ORM maps.

Package compressed KTX2/Meshopt and PNG fallback variants, preserve measured anchors and remove runtime review cameras/lights. Validate exact decoded buffers and visually inspect actual reimported exports before acceptance.

G03/G04 pilot/reference-slice acceptance is recorded in docs/visual-upgrade/reference-slice-review.json. After that acceptance, one successful authoring operation each produced A02 and A03; their source projects and receipts are indexed in the release ledger.

Integrate shared atlases, LODs and per-instance state while keeping existing flame/light ownership and gameplay coordinates. Shrine emission is independently stateful; architectural geometry cannot change gate clearance or collision contracts.

Verify active manifest hashes, real embedded texture dimensions/full mip bounds, decoded geometry and mixed-version dungeon/lightmap dependencies. Current three-prop PNG fallback set is 14.333320617675781 MiB under the 16 MiB limit.

Build only from exact source/dependency inputs, prune generated output by manifest dependency closure, then complete required checks/archive/save/publication evidence. Physical iPhone 17 Safari and broader phone results remain pending; a desktop review does not close G06.

worker_limits.images: Publish through artifacts.file(...).path then publish(); max8 image/video artifacts; PNG/JPEG/MP4 only; no invented paths or network fetches.

worker_limits.export_warning: Procedural shader/world lighting are not guaranteed inGLB. Automatic committed export may contain review camera/lights; remove them in documented local game derivative.
